class.name: FmodEventEmitter3D
class.brief_description: A 3D node that plays an FMOD Studio event and tracks its position automatically.
class.description:
FmodEventEmitter3D attaches an FMOD Studio event to a [Node3D]. When [member attached] is [code]true[/code], the event's 3D position, rotation, and velocity are updated each frame to match this node's [code]global_transform[/code], providing accurate 3D spatialization including Doppler effects.
Set [member event_name] in the Inspector or via script, optionally enable [member autoplay], and the emitter handles the rest. [codeblock] var emitter = FmodEventEmitter3D.new() emitter.event_name = "event:/Ambient/Wind" emitter.autoplay = true add_child(emitter) [/codeblock]

method.name: get_event
method.description: Returns the underlying [FmodEvent] instance, or [code]null[/code] if no event is currently loaded.

method.name: get_parameter
method.description: Returns the current value of the named event parameter.

method.name: get_parameter_by_id
method.description: Returns the current value of the event parameter with the given numerical ID.

method.name: is_paused
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the event is currently paused.

method.name: play
method.description: Starts the event. If [param restart_if_playing] is [code]true[/code] and the event is already playing, it restarts from the beginning.

method.name: play_one_shot
method.description: Plays the event as a one-shot: creates a new instance, starts it, and releases it automatically. The [member event_name] must reference a one-shot event.

method.name: set_parameter
method.description: Sets the value of the named event parameter. The change is applied immediately if the event is playing.

method.name: set_parameter_by_id
method.description: Sets the value of the event parameter with the given numerical ID.

method.name: set_programmer_callback
method.description: Sets the programmer sound key for programmer instrument callbacks on this event.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], the event fades out naturally when stopped. If [code]false[/code], it stops immediately.
If [code]true[/code], the event's 3D position, rotation, and velocity are updated each frame from this node's [code]global_transform[/code].
If [code]true[/code], the event instance is automatically released when it finishes playing.
If [code]true[/code], the event starts playing automatically when this node enters the scene tree.
The GUID of the FMOD Studio event. Set automatically when [member event_name] is assigned. Provides a stable event reference that survives event renames in FMOD Studio.
The FMOD Studio event path (e.g. [code]"event:/Ambient/Wind"[/code]). The bank containing this event must be loaded before playback.
If [code]true[/code], the event is currently paused. Does not appear in the Inspector but is accessible from script. Equivalent to calling [method set_paused] / [method is_paused].
If [code]true[/code], the event instance is created when this node enters the scene tree even if [member autoplay] is disabled. Reduces startup latency when the event needs to play quickly.
Volume multiplier for the event. [code]1.0[/code] is the volume set in FMOD Studio.

signal.name: restarted
signal.description: Emitted when the event is restarted.

signal.name: start_failed
signal.description: Emitted when the event fails to start.

signal.name: started
signal.description: Emitted when the event starts playing.

signal.name: timeline_beat
signal.description: Emitted when the event's timeline crosses a beat marker. [param params] contains beat information from FMOD.

signal.name: timeline_marker
signal.description: Emitted when the event's timeline crosses a named marker. [param params] contains marker information from FMOD.
